camel_example: aliyun sasclaw ChatUserSecAgent --region cn-hangzhou --Agent 'sec-ops-agent' --UserInputInfo '{"sessionId":"session_example","talkId":"talk_example","formId":"interaction_example","formValues":{"q1":{"kind":"selected","optionIds":["q1_o1"]}},"formAction":"submit"}' --Memory true --Channel console --TalkId 9b1e7d2c4a6f8e30 --ExecutionMode single --Attachments '["oss/input.txt","oss/raw.txt"]' --ResponseLanguage 'zh-CN' --Target 'sec-ops-team-01' --Skill 'alert-analysis' --TimeZone 'Asia/Shanghai' --ExtraParams '{"execution_mode":"team","target":"team:auto"}' --Model 'qwen-max' --Prompt '帮我梳理最近_24_小时的高危告警并给出处置建议' --Stream true --AttachmentStagingId 'stg-6f1d9c8b7a2e4530' --SessionId 5f2c1b9a8d3e4c7f --version 2026-06-26 --method POST --force
description_en: Initiates a conversation with the security agent of the current account and receives the processing progress and results through a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream
description_zh: 与当前账号的用户安全智能体进行对话，通过 SSE 事件流接收处理过程与结果
name: ChatUserSecAgent

parameters.example: 帮我梳理最近 24 小时的高危告警并给出处置建议
parameters.help_en: The text input from the user for the current turn. When initiating a new question, pass a non-empty string and specify the SessionId and a new TalkId. When submitting or canceling a form interaction, pass an empty string and provide the form information through UserInputInfo
parameters.help_zh: 用户本轮输入的文本。发起新提问时传入非空字符串，并填写 SessionId 和新的 TalkId；提交或取消表单交互时传入空字符串，并通过 UserInputInfo 传递表单信息
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the agent response as an SSE (Server-Sent Events) stream. Default value: true. When set to true, the operation continuously pushes events in a stream
parameters.help_zh: 是否以 SSE（Server-Sent Events）方式流式返回智能体的响应。默认值为 true，此时接口持续推送事件流
parameters.name: stream

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable session memory. Default value: true. When set to true, the agent references the historical context of the same session when generating responses
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用会话记忆。默认值为 true，此时智能体在生成回复时参考同一会话的历史上下文
parameters.name: memory

parameters.help_en: The execution mode for the current conversation. The execution mode is determined during the first turn of a session and is reused for subsequent turns
parameters.help_zh: 本次对话的执行模式。会话在首轮对话时确定执行模式，之后的对话沿用该模式
parameters.name: execution_mode

parameters.help_en: The execution target for the current conversation. This parameter is used together with ExecutionMode to specify the entity that handles the conversation
parameters.help_zh: 本次对话的执行目标，与 ExecutionMode 配合使用，用于指定承接本次对话的执行对象
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en: The access channel identifier from which the conversation is initiated. This parameter is used to distinguish between different calling entries
parameters.help_zh: 发起本次对话的接入渠道标识，用于区分不同调用入口
parameters.name: channel

parameters.help_en: The staging ID of the attachment referenced in the current conversation. This parameter is used to associate pre-staged attachment content
parameters.help_zh: 本次对话引用的附件暂存 ID，用于关联已提前暂存的附件内容
parameters.name: attachment_staging_id

parameters.help_en: The list of attachments for the current conversation. The OpenAPI parameter value is a JSON array string. The console uploads attachments first and then passes the OSS object identifiers returned by the upload as array elements. The path field in the frontend attachment object stores this identifier. Use the actual object identifier obtained from the upload. Do not pass a local file path from the caller's computer. A maximum of 10 attachments are supported
parameters.help_zh: 本次对话携带的附件列表，OpenAPI 参数值为 JSON 数组字符串。控制台先完成附件上传，再将上传返回的 OSS 对象标识作为数组元素传入；前端附件对象中的 path 保存该标识。请使用本次上传得到的真实对象标识，勿传入调用方计算机的本地文件路径。最多支持 10 个附件
parameters.name: attachments

parameters.help_en: The form interaction information. The value is a JSON object string. When submitting a form, set Prompt to an empty string. sessionId and talkId specify the session and turn ID to which the form belongs. formId is the Form.schema.formId returned by the agent. formAction is the interaction action. Questions forms use submit or cancel. PolicyApproval forms use approve, deny, or cancel. When submitting question answers, formValues is an object keyed by questionId: use {"kind":"selected","optionIds":["option ID"]} for selected answers and {"kind":"custom","text":"answer content"} for custom answers. Pass an empty object for cancel or approval actions. The console request must also include top-level SessionId and TalkId values that match the nested values. Do not pass this parameter for regular new questions. Do not use legacy fields such as componentId, componentValues, or dismissed
parameters.help_zh: 表单交互信息，取值为 JSON 对象字符串。提交时 Prompt 为空；sessionId、talkId 分别为表单所属会话和轮次 ID，formId 为返回的 Form.schema.formId，formAction 为交互动作。Questions 表单使用 submit 或 cancel；PolicyApproval 表单使用 approve、deny 或 cancel。提交问题答案时，formValues 为以 questionId 为键的对象：选择答案使用 {"kind":"selected","optionIds":["选项ID"]}，自定义答案使用 {"kind":"custom","text":"回答内容"}。取消或审批操作可传空对象。控制台请求同时传入与嵌套值一致的顶层 SessionId 和 TalkId。普通新提问不传此参数；不使用 componentId、componentValues、dismissed 等旧版字段
parameters.name: user_input_info

parameters.help_en: The extended parameters for the current conversation. The value is a JSON object string. The console frontend passes the execution mode and target through execution_mode and target, for example, {"execution_mode":"team","target":"team:auto"}. project_id specifies the project. result_delivery_target_ids is an array of target IDs for result delivery in the current turn. Subsequent turns in the session must retain the confirmed execution mode and target. Do not use this parameter to switch to a conflicting target
parameters.help_zh: 本次对话的扩展参数，取值为 JSON 对象字符串。控制台前端通过 execution_mode 和 target 传递执行模式与目标，例如 {"execution_mode":"team","target":"team:auto"}。project_id 用于指定项目，result_delivery_target_ids 为本轮结果投递目标 ID 数组。会话后续轮次应保持已确定的执行模式和目标，不应通过该参数切换到冲突的目标
parameters.name: extra_params

parameters.help_en: The agent identifier. The console frontend does not pass this parameter by default
parameters.help_zh: 智能体标识。当前控制台前端默认不传入此参数
parameters.name: agent

parameters.help_en: The model identifier. The console frontend does not pass this parameter by default
parameters.help_zh: 模型标识。当前控制台前端默认不传入此参数
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: The skill identifier. The console frontend does not pass this parameter by default
parameters.help_zh: 技能标识。当前控制台前端默认不传入此参数
parameters.name: skill

parameters.help_en: The conversation turn ID. The console generates and passes a new value each time a new regular question is initiated. Follow-up questions in the same session also use a new TalkId. When submitting or canceling a form, reuse the TalkId of the turn to which the form belongs. This value must match UserInputInfo.talkId
parameters.help_zh: 对话轮次 ID。控制台每次发起新的普通提问时生成并传入新值；同一会话的后续追问也使用新的 TalkId。提交或取消表单时复用该表单所属的 TalkId，并与 UserInputInfo.talkId 保持一致
parameters.name: talk_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID for a continuous conversation. The console generates and passes this value when initiating a new session. Subsequent follow-up questions reuse the same SessionId. When submitting or canceling a form, use the session ID to which the form belongs. This value must match UserInputInfo.sessionId
parameters.help_zh: 连续对话的会话 ID。控制台发起新会话时生成并传入，后续追问复用同一 SessionId。提交或取消表单时使用该表单所属的会话 ID，并与 UserInputInfo.sessionId 保持一致
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The IANA time zone name of the caller, for example, Asia/Shanghai. The console passes the browser time zone when initiating a new question. This value helps the model understand relative dates and times. It does not change how the server stores UTC timestamps
parameters.help_zh: 调用方所在的 IANA 时区名称，例如 Asia/Shanghai。控制台在发起新提问时传入浏览器时区，用于模型理解相对日期和时间；不改变服务端 UTC 时间戳的存储方式
parameters.name: time_zone

parameters.help_en: The language used for user-visible model content during the current turn. Use a valid BCP-47 language tag, such as zh-CN, en-US, or ja-JP. Do not pass an empty string or auto. The console passes the specific language corresponding to the current UI when initiating a new question
parameters.help_zh: 本轮执行中用户可见模型内容使用的语言。使用具体有效的 BCP-47 语言标识，例如 zh-CN、en-US 或 ja-JP，不能传入空字符串或 auto。控制台在发起新提问时传入当前界面对应的具体语言
parameters.name: response_language

schema.description_en:
When Stream is set to true, the response is a text/event-stream event stream. The data field of each SSE frame is a serialized JSON object string. The console parses each frame: use the type field to identify control events and the a2ui field to identify interface update messages. Do not rely solely on the event name to distinguish message purposes.

Control events

| type | Key fields | Description and processing rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| session | session_id: session ID | Confirms that the current regular chat write is attached to a session. Verify that this value matches the request SessionId. This event does not indicate task completion. |
| dispatch | taskId: task ID. target: execution target. delta: compatible field. resultDelivery: result delivery registration receipt | Indicates execution dispatch confirmation. delta may be an empty string. Do not treat this event as a model text delta. |
| error | error: original error message. code: optional error categorization. requestId: server-side diagnostic correlation ID. clientRequestId: optional caller correlation ID | Display the error and retain the diagnostic information. code and clientRequestId are not guaranteed to be present. An HTTP 200 status does not preclude an error event in the stream. |
| interaction_result | taskId: task ID. talkId: turn ID to which the form belongs | A receipt for form interaction processing. This event does not indicate that the entire turn task is complete. The final form state is determined by the subsequent A2UI update. |
| done | session_id: session ID | The current event stream has ended. Verify the session ownership, stop reading, and release the stream. Do not wait for the network connection to physically close. Do not use done alone to determine business success. |

dispatch.resultDelivery contains result delivery registration information: status=registered indicates that the delivery target selected for the current turn has been registered. status=not_requested indicates that no additional delivery was requested. targetIds is an array of target IDs and is an empty array when no delivery is requested. A successful registration does not indicate that the result has been sent to the target channel.

Note the field name casing: session and done events use session_id. A2UI messages use sessionId. taskId is the execution task identity and talkId is the conversation turn identity. These two values are not interchangeable.

A2UI message fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sessionId | string | The continuous session ID to which the message belongs. |
| talkId | string | The conversation turn ID to which the message belongs. This value is used to locate the interface for the turn. |
| taskId | string, may be empty | The associated execution task ID. This value may be empty before task dispatch. |
| eventId | string | The identifier of the current message. This value is used for event tracking and diagnostics. |
| seq | integer | The event sequence number within the current talk. Multiple interface updates may share the same seq value. Process all messages in the order they arrive. Do not discard messages solely because they share the same seq value. |
| a2ui | object | The A2UI interface instruction, which contains the version and commands for creating surfaces, declaring components, or updating data models. |

The surfaceId in a2ui must match the outer talkId. createSurface creates the interface for the turn. updateComponents declares the complete component structure. updateDataModel updates the data attached to components. When updateDataModel.isDelta is set to true, the value is appended only to already-initialized strings. When isDelta is omitted or set to false, the value is replaced in full. Render the body, procedure, forms, and task results based on the component declarations and data bindings.

Ordering and completion

After a regular chat write is accepted, a session event is returned first, followed by dispatch and interface update events. If the request is denied before admission, an error and done event may be returned directly without a session event. Errors may also occur during execution. Do not treat session, dispatch, or an HTTP 200 status as an indication of business success.

Stop reading after receiving a done event for the associated session. Determine the task result by combining error messages and the A2UI final-state content. If you encounter an EOF, network disconnection, or proxy interruption before receiving done, treat the stream as incomplete. The interaction_result receipt cannot replace the A2UI state or done event.

The response example shows a complete denial event stream. The following is an A2UI final-state update snippet from a normal execution, provided only to illustrate the field structure. It omits the preceding surface creation, component declarations, and other data updates, and cannot be used as a complete renderable event stream:

```text
event: message
data: {"sessionId":"session_example","talkId":"talk_example","taskId":"task_example","eventId":"evt_example","seq":7,"a2ui":{"version":"v0.9","updateDataModel":{"surfaceId":"talk_example","path":"/surface/isDone","value":true}}}

event: message
data: {"type":"done","session_id":"session_example"}

```
schema.description_zh:
当 Stream=true 时，响应为 text/event-stream 事件流。每个 SSE 数据帧的 data 是一个 JSON 对象的序列化字符串。控制台逐帧解析 data：通过 type 识别控制事件，通过 a2ui 识别界面更新消息；不要仅依靠 event 名区分消息用途。

控制事件

| type | 主要字段 | 含义与处理规则 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| session | session_id：会话 ID | 确认本次普通聊天写入已绑定会话。校验其与请求 SessionId 一致；不代表任务已经完成。 |
| dispatch | taskId：任务 ID；target：执行目标；delta：兼容字段；resultDelivery：结果投递登记回执 | 表示执行分派确认。delta 可为空字符串，不应将该事件当作模型文本增量。 |
| error | error：错误原文；code：可选错误分类；requestId：服务端诊断关联 ID；clientRequestId：可选调用方关联 ID | 展示错误并保留诊断信息。code 和 clientRequestId 不保证出现；HTTP 200 并不排除流中出现 error。 |
| interaction_result | taskId：任务 ID；talkId：表单所属轮次 ID | 表单交互处理的回执，不代表整轮任务完成；表单最终状态仍以随后返回的 A2UI 更新为准。 |
| done | session_id：会话 ID | 本次事件流结束。校验会话归属后停止读取并释放流，不再等待网络连接物理关闭；不能仅凭 done 判断业务成功。 |

dispatch.resultDelivery 为结果投递登记信息：status=registered 表示本轮选择的投递目标已登记，status=not_requested 表示未请求额外投递；targetIds 为目标 ID 数组，未请求时为空数组。登记成功不表示结果已经发送到目标渠道。

注意字段大小写：session 和 done 使用 session_id；A2UI 消息使用 sessionId。taskId 是执行任务身份，talkId 是对话轮次身份，两者不能互换。

A2UI 消息字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sessionId | string | 消息所属连续会话 ID。 |
| talkId | string | 消息所属对话轮次 ID，用于定位该轮界面。 |
| taskId | string，可为空 | 关联的执行任务 ID；任务分派前允许为空。 |
| eventId | string | 当前消息标识，用于事件追踪和诊断。 |
| seq | integer | 当前 Talk 内的事件序号。多个界面更新可共享同一 seq；按到达顺序全部处理，不得仅因 seq 相同而丢弃消息。 |
| a2ui | object | A2UI 界面指令，包含版本及创建界面、声明组件或更新数据模型的命令。 |

a2ui 中的 surfaceId 应与外层 talkId 一致。createSurface 创建该轮界面；updateComponents 声明完整组件结构；updateDataModel 更新组件绑定的数据。updateDataModel.isDelta=true 时，仅对已初始化的字符串执行追加；省略或为 false 时按完整值替换。正文、过程、表单和结果应依据组件声明及数据绑定渲染。

顺序与结束判断

普通聊天写入被接纳后先返回 session，随后返回分派和界面更新。准入前拒绝请求时可以直接返回 error、done，而没有 session。执行过程中也可能出现 error，因此不要把 session、dispatch 或 HTTP 200 当作业务成功。

收到所属会话的 done 后结束本次读取。任务结果应结合错误消息和 A2UI 终态内容判断；在收到 done 前遇到 EOF、断网或代理中断，应按流未完整结束处理。表单回执 interaction_result 同样不能替代 A2UI 状态或 done。

响应示例展示一条完整的拒绝事件流。以下是正常执行中的 A2UI 终态更新片段，仅用于说明字段形状，省略了此前创建界面、组件声明和其他数据更新，不可作为完整可渲染事件流：

```text
event: message
data: {"sessionId":"session_example","talkId":"talk_example","taskId":"task_example","eventId":"evt_example","seq":7,"a2ui":{"version":"v0.9","updateDataModel":{"surfaceId":"talk_example","path":"/surface/isDone","value":true}}}

event: message
data: {"type":"done","session_id":"session_example"}

```
